Title: Ireland – Road transport services – Distribution Service for the HSE National Distribution Centre in Tullamore
Procedure title: Distribution Service for the HSE National Distribution Centre in Tullamore
Description: The HSE intends to tender for the provision of a distribution service on behalf of the HSE National Distribution Centre located in Burlington Business Park, Sragh Road, Tullamore, Co. Offaly, R35 F7X4. The NDC is responsible for the purchase, storage and distribution of dry non-hazardous goods and some products which are classified as dangerous goods in accordance with the ADR regulation to regional warehouse hubs and healthcare facilities nationwide. The NDC is also responsible for the purchase, storage and distribution of Goods directly to healthcare facilities in the four midland counties in Ireland.
